name: Vietnam prohibited, restricted and danger areas
nameZh: 越南禁区、限制区和危险区

layers.label: Airport drone restricted zone (Decision 18/2020)
layers.summary: Area adjoining an airport prohibited zone (3 km each side, 5 km at each end; Decision 18/2020/QD-TTg Art. 4(4)): flight only with the permission of the competent authority. Rectangle built from the AIP runway thresholds; verify with current Vietnamese rules.

layers.label: Airport drone prohibited zone (Decision 18/2020)
layers.summary: Drone flight not permitted: rectangle 15 km beyond the runway thresholds and 5 km either side of the runway centreline, all altitudes (Decision 18/2020/QD-TTg Art. 3(4)). Airports with fewer than 6 civil flights a day may use a flexible zone with military and air traffic approval; flight counts are not mapped. Verify with current Vietnamese rules.

layers.label: Prohibited area (P)
layers.summary: Prohibited area (ENR 5.1): flight of aircraft is not permitted at any time.

layers.label: Restricted area (R)
layers.summary: Restricted area (ENR 5.1): flight is allowed only if the published conditions are met. Read the times and conditions.

layers.label: Danger area (D)
layers.summary: Danger area (ENR 5.1): activities dangerous to aircraft may exist at the published times. Caution; check the conditions.

layers.label: Restricted area (R), approximate boundary
layers.summary: Potential restricted area: boundary approximated from the official AIP Viet Nam ENR 5.1 text and chart (a referenced or malformed definition could not be converted exactly), not an exact AIP polygon. Verify with current AIP Viet Nam information.

layers.label: Danger area (D), approximate boundary
layers.summary: Potential danger area: boundary approximated from the official AIP Viet Nam ENR 5.1 text and chart (a referenced or malformed definition could not be converted exactly), not an exact AIP polygon. Verify with current AIP Viet Nam information.

source.authority: Vietnam Air Traffic Management Corporation (VATM), AIS, AIP Viet Nam ENR 5.1
source.extraction: scripts/airspace/vn-enr51.mjs (parses the published tabulation; see exceptions.json for what was not converted); the three areas it cannot convert are approximated by scripts/airspace/vn-enr51-approx.mjs (layers approx-*, approx-provenance.json)

aerodromeZones.rule: Decision 18/2020/QD-TTg (10 June 2020), Art. 3(4) and 4(4); runway thresholds from AIP Viet Nam AD 2.12

licenseNote: Derived from the public Vietnam eAIP (aim.vatm.vn). No reuse terms were checked or found; published on the owner's authorization of 2026-11-24 as planning reference, with the geometry reconstructed independently from the published coordinates. Partial coverage; VVR19, VVD43 and VVD45 are shipped as approximate layers (approx-provenance.json). Remove this region (or set publish to false) if VATM asks. Aerodrome zones: runway-based rectangles per Decision 18/2020/QD-TTg, built from the AIP AD 2.12 threshold coordinates (same unknown licence status); the 2020 Decision was read in English translation and its current effect status is unconfirmed.
